Requirement: Application VM shall remain within 6.0-12.6 V
Local VM decoupling shall meet or exceed DRV8848 datasheet minimum
nSLEEP shall provide a system-level disabled state during controller startup
nFAULT shall be exposed to the controller and a test point
Nominal chopping current shall remain below 1 A per bridge
Worst-case modeled current limit including VINT and resistor tolerance shall remain below 1 A
Each current-sense resistor shall be rated with <=50% nominal power utilization at configured limit
PowerPAD shall connect to ground copper with thermal-via strategy
Dual-channel maximum intended operating condition shall be thermally validated on hardware
High-current VM/output/sense loops shall follow documented placement rules
Required validation test points shall be accessible
Input overcurrent protection shall be selected for the final source and harness
Reverse-polarity protection shall be selected for the final source
Transient suppression shall be selected from real source/harness transient behavior
ERC and DRC shall pass or every waiver shall be documented before fabrication release
Gerber/drill outputs shall receive visual CAM review before order
No hardware-validated claim shall be made before fabrication, inspection, power-up, motor, thermal and stall evidence exists
